name: proofshield-root
description: ProofShield - Blockchain-Based Digital Evidence Tamper Detection System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix blockchain && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.blockchain:deploy: cd blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network localhost
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run blockchain:node" "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate && npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all
